text:
mike: Hey folks — pharmacy called, my new specialty script for tofacitinib (prescribed by Dr. Wong) was rejected: "prior auth required; step therapy not met." I stopped methotrexate last year due to liver enzymes. What's the fastest path so I can pick this up?
maya (People Ops): Ugh. Two parallel actions: 1) Have Dr. Wong submit a Prior Authorization (PA) with a step-therapy override request citing methotrexate intolerance; 2) Pharmacy can submit an urgent PA request on the provider's behalf. If the med is urgent ask for "expedited review."
pharmacy-help: We can initiate a PA but need the provider's clinical notes and intolerance documentation. If provider marks "medically necessary" and requests step therapy override we'll push as expedited. Provide NPI, Rx#, and preferred pharmacy contact.
dr-wong-praxis: We can submit a PA today. What exact language speeds payer review for a step override?
maya (People Ops): Ask Dr. Wong to include: - Diagnosis with ICD-10 - Prior meds with dates (e.g., methotrexate discontinued 03/2025 due to elevated LFTs) - Labs showing intolerance (ALT/AST values) - Statement: "Patient has tried and not tolerated first-line therapy; tofacitinib is medically necessary" - Request expedited review and include contact phone/fax.
pharmacy-help: Template we send to payers in the comments field (short): "Requesting PA with step-therapy override for tofacitinib. Patient has documented methotrexate intolerance (ALT 5x ULN on 02/10/2025). Provider: Dr. Wong, NPI ######. Urgent: risk of disease flare without therapy."
anthem-support: Hi Mike  we can do an expedited PA review if provider marks "urgent" and attaches clinical notes/labs. Please DM member ID, Rx#, and we'll flag it. Standard expedited window is 72 hours; non-urgent ~7-14 days. If denied, you can request internal appeal and submit physician-to-physician peer-to-peer review.
mike: Thanks everyone. Dr. Wong's office said they'll fax clinical notes and ALT/AST labs and mark urgent. @anthem-support I'll DM the member ID + Rx once fax complete. Appreciate the clear template — saves time. :thumbsup:
